⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
The codec used to encode audio stored in [`components.AudioChunk`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_chunk?speculative-link).

Enum values are the big-endian packing of the `WebCodecs` audio codec string
(same convention used by [`components.VideoCodec`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/video_codec)).

Support of these codecs by the Rerun Viewer is platform dependent.

## Variants
#### `Flac` = 0x666C6163
Free Lossless Audio Codec (FLAC).

Each [`components.AudioChunk`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_chunk?speculative-link) is expected to contain one or more complete FLAC frames.

Enum value is the fourcc for `'flac'` (the `WebCodecs` string for FLAC) in big endian.

#### `Opus` = 0x6F707573
Opus — RFC 6716.

Streams are expected to contain one or more raw Opus packets per
[`components.AudioChunk`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_chunk?speculative-link). Any sample rate supported by the decoder
(8/12/16/24/48 kHz) is valid. Libopus handles internal resampling to
48 kHz but the logged [`components.AudioSampleRate`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_sample_rate?speculative-link) is treated as
authoritative for downstream analysis.

Enum value is the fourcc for `'opus'` (the `WebCodecs` string for Opus) in big endian.
